summary: Saga Communications filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per Class A share, declared by its Board on September 10, 2026. Record date is September 23, 2026, with payment October 16, 2026; aggregate outlay is roughly $1.6 million, funded from balance-sheet cash. Including this payout, Saga has distributed over $146 million since its first special dividend in 2012, and management intends to keep declaring regular quarterly dividends subject to Board discretion. No advisor or close date is stated. The event signals continued shareholder returns with no structural or deal overhang; watch for future dividend declarations versus buybacks given cash needs.
